name: Orbital Economy v7.7.4 Capital Goods Capital candidate r1
description: Task 014: capital-goods production capacity becomes a kernel-v2 lifecycle-capital sector in each colony. Required capacity follows a new smoothed Capital Goods Demand Signal to break the same-step demand/expansion loop.

add_elements.name: Capital Goods Capital Enabled
add_elements.description: v7.7.4 switch: enables capital-goods production capacity as lifecycle capital.

add_elements.name: Capital Goods Demand Signal Adjustment Time
add_elements.description: Adjustment time for the smoothed Capital Goods demand signal.

add_elements.name: A Capital Goods Demand Signal
add_elements.description: Smoothed Capital Goods demand signal for colony A; breaks same-step plant-demand causality.

add_elements.name: A Capital Goods Demand Signal Increase

behavior.value: IfThenElse([A Capital Goods Demand] > [A Capital Goods Demand Signal], ([A Capital Goods Demand] - [A Capital Goods Demand Signal]) / [Capital Goods Demand Signal Adjustment Time], 0)

add_elements.description: Upward adjustment of colony A Capital Goods demand signal.

add_elements.name: A Capital Goods Demand Signal Decrease

behavior.value: IfThenElse([A Capital Goods Demand Signal] > [A Capital Goods Demand], ([A Capital Goods Demand Signal] - [A Capital Goods Demand]) / [Capital Goods Demand Signal Adjustment Time], 0)

add_elements.description: Downward adjustment of colony A Capital Goods demand signal.

add_elements.name: B Capital Goods Demand Signal
add_elements.description: Smoothed Capital Goods demand signal for colony B; breaks same-step plant-demand causality.

add_elements.name: B Capital Goods Demand Signal Increase

behavior.value: IfThenElse([B Capital Goods Demand] > [B Capital Goods Demand Signal], ([B Capital Goods Demand] - [B Capital Goods Demand Signal]) / [Capital Goods Demand Signal Adjustment Time], 0)

add_elements.description: Upward adjustment of colony B Capital Goods demand signal.

add_elements.name: B Capital Goods Demand Signal Decrease

behavior.value: IfThenElse([B Capital Goods Demand Signal] > [B Capital Goods Demand], ([B Capital Goods Demand Signal] - [B Capital Goods Demand]) / [Capital Goods Demand Signal Adjustment Time], 0)

add_elements.description: Downward adjustment of colony B Capital Goods demand signal.

add_elements.name: Capital Goods Plant Operating Reserve Factor
add_elements.description: Required active plant capacity multiplier over the smoothed construction-materials demand signal.

add_elements.name: Capital Goods Plant Installed Reserve Factor
add_elements.description: Desired installed plant capacity multiplier over required active capacity.

add_elements.name: Capital Goods Plant Activation Time
add_elements.description: Days to reactivate mothballed capital-goods plant capacity.

add_elements.name: Capital Goods Plant Mothball Time
add_elements.description: Days to mothball unneeded active capital-goods plant capacity.

add_elements.name: Capital Goods Plant Surplus Disposal Decision Time
add_elements.description: Decision timescale before true surplus plant capacity enters decommissioning.

add_elements.name: Capital Goods Plant Construction Time
add_elements.description: Physical timescale for closing an installed capital-goods plant capacity shortage.

add_elements.name: Capital Goods Plant Decommissioning Time
add_elements.description: Physical timescale from decommissioning commitment to retirement.

add_elements.name: Capital Goods Plant Depreciation Rate
add_elements.description: Daily physical depreciation rate of capital-goods plant capacity.

add_elements.name: Capital Goods Plant Capital Goods per Capacity
add_elements.description: Capital Goods consumed per unit of new capital-goods plant capacity.

add_elements.name: Capital Goods Plant Construction Materials per Capacity
add_elements.description: Construction Materials consumed per unit of new capital-goods plant capacity.

add_elements.name: A Capital Goods Plant Installed Capacity
add_elements.description: Physical installed capital-goods production capacity in colony A.

add_elements.name: A Capital Goods Plant Active Capacity
add_elements.description: Operational capital-goods production capacity in colony A.

add_elements.name: A Capital Goods Plant Decommissioning Capacity
add_elements.description: Construction-materials plant capacity committed to decommissioning in colony A.

add_elements.name: A Capital Goods Plant Retired Capacity
add_elements.description: Cumulative retired capital-goods plant capacity in colony A.

add_elements.name: A Capital Goods Plant Required Active Capacity

behavior.value: [A Capital Goods Demand Signal] * [Capital Goods Plant Operating Reserve Factor]

add_elements.description: Required active plant capacity follows the smoothed demand signal, preserving same-step causality.

add_elements.name: A Capital Goods Plant Desired Installed Capacity

behavior.value: [A Capital Goods Plant Required Active Capacity] * [Capital Goods Plant Installed Reserve Factor]

add_elements.description: Long-run desired installed capital-goods plant capacity.

add_elements.name: A Capital Goods Plant Inactive Capacity

behavior.value: (([A Capital Goods Plant Installed Capacity] - [A Capital Goods Plant Active Capacity]) + ((([A Capital Goods Plant Installed Capacity] - [A Capital Goods Plant Active Capacity]) ^ 2) ^ 0.5)) / 2

add_elements.description: Installed but inactive capital-goods plant capacity.

add_elements.name: A Capital Goods Plant Target Active Capacity

behavior.value: (([A Capital Goods Plant Required Active Capacity]) + ([A Capital Goods Plant Installed Capacity]) - (((([A Capital Goods Plant Required Active Capacity]) - ([A Capital Goods Plant Installed Capacity])) ^ 2) ^ 0.5)) / 2

add_elements.description: Active-capacity target bounded by installed capacity.

add_elements.name: A Capital Goods Plant Activation Gap

behavior.value: (([A Capital Goods Plant Target Active Capacity] - [A Capital Goods Plant Active Capacity]) + ((([A Capital Goods Plant Target Active Capacity] - [A Capital Goods Plant Active Capacity]) ^ 2) ^ 0.5)) / 2

add_elements.description: Positive activation gap.

add_elements.name: A Capital Goods Plant Mothball Gap

behavior.value: (([A Capital Goods Plant Active Capacity] - [A Capital Goods Plant Target Active Capacity]) + ((([A Capital Goods Plant Active Capacity] - [A Capital Goods Plant Target Active Capacity]) ^ 2) ^ 0.5)) / 2

add_elements.description: Positive mothballing gap.

add_elements.name: A Capital Goods Plant Installed Capacity Shortage

behavior.value: (([A Capital Goods Plant Desired Installed Capacity] - [A Capital Goods Plant Installed Capacity]) + ((([A Capital Goods Plant Desired Installed Capacity] - [A Capital Goods Plant Installed Capacity]) ^ 2) ^ 0.5)) / 2

add_elements.description: Positive installed-capacity shortage.

add_elements.name: A Capital Goods Plant Installed Capacity Excess

behavior.value: (([A Capital Goods Plant Installed Capacity] - [A Capital Goods Plant Desired Installed Capacity]) + ((([A Capital Goods Plant Installed Capacity] - [A Capital Goods Plant Desired Installed Capacity]) ^ 2) ^ 0.5)) / 2

add_elements.description: Positive installed-capacity excess.

add_elements.name: A Capital Goods Plant Gap Limited Construction

behavior.value: [A Capital Goods Plant Installed Capacity Shortage] / [Capital Goods Plant Construction Time]

add_elements.description: Maximum construction rate justified by the installed-capacity shortage.

add_elements.name: A Capital Goods Plant Activation Queue Capacity

behavior.value: (([A Capital Goods Plant Inactive Capacity]) + ([A Capital Goods Plant Activation Gap]) - (((([A Capital Goods Plant Inactive Capacity]) - ([A Capital Goods Plant Activation Gap])) ^ 2) ^ 0.5)) / 2

add_elements.description: Inactive capacity already needed to close the activation gap.

add_elements.name: A Capital Goods Plant Inactive After Activation Queue

behavior.value: (([A Capital Goods Plant Inactive Capacity] - [A Capital Goods Plant Activation Queue Capacity]) + ((([A Capital Goods Plant Inactive Capacity] - [A Capital Goods Plant Activation Queue Capacity]) ^ 2) ^ 0.5)) / 2

add_elements.description: Inactive capacity remaining after activation needs are reserved.

add_elements.name: A Capital Goods Plant Strategic Reserve Target

behavior.value: (([A Capital Goods Plant Desired Installed Capacity] - [A Capital Goods Plant Required Active Capacity]) + ((([A Capital Goods Plant Desired Installed Capacity] - [A Capital Goods Plant Required Active Capacity]) ^ 2) ^ 0.5)) / 2

add_elements.description: Desired inactive strategic reserve implied by installed reserve.

add_elements.name: A Capital Goods Plant Strategic Reserve Capacity

behavior.value: (([A Capital Goods Plant Inactive After Activation Queue]) + ([A Capital Goods Plant Strategic Reserve Target]) - (((([A Capital Goods Plant Inactive After Activation Queue]) - ([A Capital Goods Plant Strategic Reserve Target])) ^ 2) ^ 0.5)) / 2

add_elements.description: Inactive capital-goods plant capacity intentionally retained as strategic reserve.

add_elements.name: A Capital Goods Plant Surplus Capacity

behavior.value: (([A Capital Goods Plant Inactive After Activation Queue] - [A Capital Goods Plant Strategic Reserve Capacity]) + ((([A Capital Goods Plant Inactive After Activation Queue] - [A Capital Goods Plant Strategic Reserve Capacity]) ^ 2) ^ 0.5)) / 2

add_elements.description: True surplus plant capacity eligible for decommissioning.

add_elements.name: A Capital Goods Plant Lifetime Capacity Account

behavior.value: [A Capital Goods Plant Installed Capacity] + [A Capital Goods Plant Decommissioning Capacity] + [A Capital Goods Plant Retired Capacity]

add_elements.description: Lifetime accounting identity for constructed plant capacity.

add_elements.name: A Capital Goods Plant Desired Expansion

behavior.value: IfThenElse([Capital Goods Capital Enabled] = 1, [A Capital Goods Plant Gap Limited Construction], 0)

add_elements.description: Desired capital-goods plant expansion; no finance limit, gated only by the v7.7.4 switch.

add_elements.name: A Capital Goods Plant Expansion
add_elements.to: A Capital Goods Plant Installed Capacity

behavior.value: IfThenElse([Capital Goods Capital Enabled] = 1, [A Capital Goods Plant Gap Limited Construction] * Min([A Capital Goods Fulfillment], [A Construction Materials Fulfillment]), 0)

add_elements.description: Actual plant expansion after physical Capital Goods and Construction Materials fulfillment.

add_elements.name: A Capital Goods Plant Decommissioning Initiation
add_elements.from: A Capital Goods Plant Installed Capacity
add_elements.to: A Capital Goods Plant Decommissioning Capacity

behavior.value: [A Capital Goods Plant Surplus Capacity] / [Capital Goods Plant Surplus Disposal Decision Time]

add_elements.description: Commitment of true surplus plant capacity to decommissioning.

add_elements.name: A Capital Goods Plant Depreciation
add_elements.from: A Capital Goods Plant Installed Capacity
add_elements.to: A Capital Goods Plant Retired Capacity

behavior.value: [A Capital Goods Plant Installed Capacity] * [Capital Goods Plant Depreciation Rate]

add_elements.description: Installed plant capacity lost to physical depreciation.

add_elements.from: A Capital Goods Plant Decommissioning Capacity
add_elements.to: A Capital Goods Plant Retired Capacity

behavior.value: [A Capital Goods Plant Decommissioning Capacity] / [Capital Goods Plant Decommissioning Time]

add_elements.to: A Capital Goods Plant Active Capacity

add_elements.from: A Capital Goods Plant Active Capacity

behavior.value: [A Capital Goods Plant Active Capacity] * [Capital Goods Plant Depreciation Rate]
